raised: The guide says 'a period set by law' but never says how long that is
The home link promised 'what it costs', but the guide page it leads to shows no cost
Top menu items 'השקעה במדד' and 'פרמטרים' mean nothing to the reader
'Everything stays on your device' was not fully understood
The 'what's your question?' form was confusing and asks for money figures before the reader understands anything
Unclear what pressing the 'קרן השתלמות' button in the form would do
'Enter from your annual statement' put the reader off
The search box about 'what you saw in the app' does not apply to the reader
The jargon 'מסלול' (track) and 'קופה' (fund) is not understood
'Cash, bonds, a stock index' in 'two parts of every saving' lost the reader
Can't tell 'קרן חדשה מקיפה' from 'קרן חדשה כללית', or which one they have
'Personally managed' sounds like it is meant for experts
'What the money is invested in' is a wall of English index names, and the dollar-hedging wording feels untrustworthy
Not every card has a 'in plain words' line
Bond terms (linked or not linked to the index, coupon, a fund that tracks it) are not understood
Unclear what the 'מה הכי מתאים' button would do with their numbers
Can't find whether it's still worth it at 61 or when they can withdraw
Can't find how to check whether they already have a fund and where it is
Can't find what happens to the money if they stop working
Would drop the investment, own-choice and children sections, and move the money form further down the home page

problems.why: The reader says the home link 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' promised cost details but led to a general guide page that doesn't give them. The person would recognise this as part of their own complaint: the link promises more than its destination delivers.
